Chapter 6562: Come

Chapter 6562: Come

Xian Chengtian smiled, aware of the ghost’s excitement from changing the status quo.

Not to mention regular cultivators, even an overlord paled to him when it came to appearance and aura.

“You’ve been waiting for a long time until you’re strong enough to defeat me.” Chengtian said: “But even after accomplishing this, it doesn’t change your inferior mindset and heart devil. The abyss in your heart will always be there.”

Although their cultivation seemed equal now, Chengtian’s natural immortal dao made the ghost feel like a clown.

He had shown his ugliest side to Chengtian previously and begged for help. Thus, this became a mental issue as well.

His achievements didn’t make up for this dark past, hence his feeling of inferiority. This was unacceptable to someone aspiring to become immortal.

“Are we so different? You showed treachery and wretchedness when you betrayed your masters, I’m sure you can’t forget it...” The ghost said.

“You’re mistaken.” Chengtian shook his head and said: “The betrayal is not my heart devil. I did what I should have and have no problem meeting them again, face to face.”

Chengtian commented on his treacherous past without any issue as if it was unavoidable.

“Wow, this brat is something else.” An overlord back in Heaven World was at a loss for words.

The ghost understood and nodded: “True, this isn’t your heart devil but rather, the heart devil is the reason for it. You consider yourself a great talent, destined to be an immortal, but are still only an overlord despite your masters’ effort. Thus, you sold them to obtain their legacy, a truly shameless move. If only you were more capable, you would have become an immortal long ago instead of having to resort to such a despicable and shameful method. Perhaps you aren’t as talented as you think you are.”

He didn’t miss an opportunity to stab Chengtian where it hurts.

Xian Chengtian’s expression darkened, clearly affected by the comment. Betraying his masters was not an issue but his inability to become an immortal was a different matter.

He couldn’t become one with their help and after his betrayal, they cursed him to never reach the next stage. His efforts and talents weren’t enough to break this curse.

This was one of the biggest flaws in his dao heart, weakening him mentally.

“We will see if your skill is as sharp as your tongue.” Chengtian glared at the opponent.

The ghost’s determination to kill Chengtian only grew with time. He had never thought about disrespecting Chengtian in the past but things changed so quickly.

“Brother, show me your immortal arts, the power of the primordial.” He said, having made up his mind and dispelling all hesitation.

His yin energy made him look massive. His silhouette became clear, no longer fusing into the night. This image left an indelible impression because although he was an overlord, he was hidden in the darkness.

Now, he revealed himself and looked rather heroic, only slightly inferior to Xian Chengtian.

“This is the young genius back then, it’s how an overlord should be.” An ancient progenitor recalled the past.

“Very well, you will see the power of the primordial.” Xian Chengtian summoned a different weapon. Even supreme overlords felt a sharp pain in their throat.
